ideas.title: Following the Money in the Minnesota Fraud Scandal
ideas.description: This story would investigate the financial trail of the alleged fraud in Minnesota, including the sources of funding and the individuals and organizations involved.
questions: What are the sources of funding for the alleged fraud?
Who are the individuals and organizations involved in the scandal?
ideas.insight: As an investigator, I believe that following the money is key to uncovering the truth behind the Minnesota fraud scandal. By tracing the financial trail, we can identify the individuals and organizations involved and hold them accountable for their actions.
